supporting_observations.claim: The supplied records do not contain a PowerShell process-creation event or other direct evidence confirming the briefly visible PowerShell window at about 13:40 UTC.

In the minutes before the reported window, WS-JFROST-01 made an SMB connection to DC-MAP-01 using its machine account, followed by Kerberos and LDAP activity. These records do not identify a PowerShell process or show that this activity caused the reported window.

At 13:44:52 UTC, the proxy recorded a successful request by julia.frost from WS-JFROST-01 for https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maplehill-it/tools/main/u.ps1. This occurred after the reported window; the records do not establish that the file was executed or related to the alert.
